articles.title: Wall Street Fear Index Spikes After Trump Address Fails to Reassure Investors
articles.mainIdea: Wall Street Fear Index Spikes After Trump Address Fails to Reassure Investors
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Wall Street Fear Index Spikes After Trump Address Fails to Reassure Investors. Wall Street was feeling on edge on Thursday after President Donald Trump's address on Iran gave the market cause to rethink a recent rally. The widely followed fear gauge was rallying after Trump said the U.S. would "hit [Iran] extremely hard over the next two to three weeks,” without giving further clarity on the war’s timeline.
